facts.truth: One row is one vendor program (a contract term with dates); there are 7 rows.
Gulf Breeze Produce has two rows (2024-25 and 2026-27 programs); joining purchases on Vendor alone duplicates its lines, so match on dates too.
Mangrove Coffee Roasters appears in the purchase Detail but has no contract row; it is bought at list price.
The contracts file writes "Sunrise Dairy Co." with a trailing period while Detail writes "Sunrise Dairy Co"; they are the same vendor.
Rebate % is in percent points: 2.0 means 2 percent.
Rebates are paid quarterly by check on net product spend excluding fees and commissary transfers; they never appear on invoice lines.
Coastline Provisions' terms waive fuel surcharges for the term; Bayfront ($9.50), Gulf Breeze ($6.00) and Tidewater ($8.00) may charge one per delivery.
Bayfront Meats prices are fixed per the Price File from 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.
The Tidewater Seafood contract ended 2026-02-28; the group has bought month to month on the same terms since.
The Coastline Provisions contract ends 2026-09-30 and the owner is preparing the renewal.
Cost plus $2.10 per case means Coastline may charge its landed cost plus a flat $2.10 per case; the landed cost itself is not in either file.

owner_brief:
You are Renee Castillo, Director of Purchasing for Gulfside Hospitality Group (three hotels: Palm Key, Harborlight, Sandpiper, plus a commissary coded CMSY). You keep procurement_contracts.xlsx: one row per vendor program with its terms, dates and rebate rate.

Coastline Provisions is the broadline prime vendor: cost plus $2.10 per case on their landed cost (you never see their cost), fuel surcharge waived, 2% rebate paid quarterly; it ends September 30, 2026 and you are preparing the renewal. Bayfront Meats has fixed prices per the Price File from July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026; the prior 2024 Bayfront contract is not in this file. Gulf Breeze Produce renewed in January 2026, so it has two rows; the right one is whichever covers the invoice date. Sunrise Dairy is written with a trailing period here but is the same vendor as in the purchase data. Keystone Paper & Chem reprices its list every January. Tidewater Seafood's contract ended February 28, 2026 and you are month to month on the same terms. Mangrove Coffee Roasters has no contract at all.

Rebate % is in percent points (2.0 means 2%). Rebates arrive by check each quarter on net product spend excluding fees and commissary transfers; they never show up on invoices.

Answer only what you are asked, briefly. If a question is not covered here, say "not sure".

eval_questions.q: How many distinct vendors have a contract row, and how many rows are there?
eval_questions.a: 6 vendors on 7 rows (one vendor has two program rows).

eval_questions.q: Which vendor appears on more than one row, and how do you pick the right row for a purchase?
eval_questions.a: Gulf Breeze Produce has two programs (2024-25 and 2026-27). Pick the row whose Start to End covers the invoice date.

eval_questions.q: Which contract rows had already ended by June 30, 2026?
eval_questions.a: Gulf Breeze Produce | Produce Market Program 2024-25; Tidewater Seafood | Seafood Market.
value: Gulf Breeze Produce | Produce Market Program 2024-25

eval_questions.q: Which vendor has the highest rebate rate, and what is it?
eval_questions.a: Keystone Paper & Chem at 3% (Rebate % is in percent points, so 3.0 means 3%).

eval_questions.q: Which vendors may charge a fuel surcharge under their terms, at what rate, and which contract waives it?
eval_questions.a: Allowed: Bayfront Meats $9.50 per delivery; Gulf Breeze Produce $6.00 per delivery; Tidewater Seafood $8.00 per delivery. Waived: Coastline Provisions.

eval_questions.q: Which Gulf Breeze Produce program applied to an invoice dated 2025-11-15?
Which vendor in the purchase Detail has no contract row at all, and which vendor only matches if you ignore punctuation?
eval_questions.a: No contract: Mangrove Coffee Roasters. Sunrise Dairy Co is written with a trailing period in the contracts file, so an exact-text join misses it.

eval_questions.q: As of June 30, 2026, which contract still in force ends first after that date?
eval_questions.a: Coastline Provisions, Broadline Prime Vendor, ends 2026-09-30.

eval_questions.q: Can you see rebate payments anywhere in these two files?
eval_questions.a: No. Rebate % is a contract term; the rebates themselves are paid quarterly by check and never appear on invoice lines.
